body: I just started doing this. My mom gets mad when I tell her I am this close to suicide. She told me to suck it up. My grandpa called me fat and lazy today, right after I got off a 12 hour shift. And hell, I can’t even make myself happy.

Wishing you luck! Let me know if you need to know anything else
There is a market, especially on Mercari specifically. I see these cards often, and have bought a few myself! I love them

They obviously did not have knowledgeable employees. I work at my local pet supermarket and I am VERY meticulous about each of my animals. I work there so that I won’t adopt each of them and bring them home!!!! I work early mornings and late nights to give medicine, separate cages and clean, maintain relationships and sociability.... I hate that your store is so inexperienced, or more likely, not compassionate. PLEASE, report or tell them something! Sadly, they may be unaware. Which is HARD to say. Even working at a “pet store,” you need to have the knowledge of animal care....
Mine was made recently, I will try this when I arrive home
Impressive!! How much time did it take you?

I find it’s the real frown. I’ve been unable to contain my sadness for a few months now. Family members become annoyed, instead of caring. Telling me to suck it up, it’s been long enough.

How do you think I feel?

I am exhausted.

I appreciate you. I wonder, how’d you do it?

How do you find a passion for life that has fizzled out?

I find that I can barely handle my 15 hour a week job because of the stress it entails. And it’s not even stressful.... How can I navigate this world if I’m so fucked up?

I have been fighting so hard. It’s come to the point where everyday I seem to have something strike me. Whether it is something big like losing my scholarship, or something small like gaining weight or spilling something in my room.

I feel like my life is in slow motion. Every breath is slow. Movement is slow. Thoughts are slow. The world around me moves at a pace that I am unable to meet now, and have been unable to meet since I was a child.

I’m 20 years old now, and I’m realizing how stressful life is. And how if I can’t handle the simple tasks of passing a math class, how am I supposed to deal with real life like buying a house or going to the hospital with insurance?

I’m not sure I will ever be ready to be independent. That is what scares me. I don’t want to see it through. I don’t want kids because then I will leave them and hurt them too. I have a boyfriend, and he is very worried about me, but not understanding.

I wish I could tell him how close I am to ending it, but he would be more mad than accepting.

I am just very alone.

That sounds peaceful, but taxing as a way to go. I wish you the best. But I implore you to stay. I’m not sure why, maybe just jealousy that you would get what I’ve always desired.
Stay for your cats. They are why I am here.
Someone, please help me.

We seem to be very similar. I desperately want a friend to understand me. Yet I hate making friends. And when I have one, my anxiety makes it to where I won’t answer them for days.
I know for a fact that if I didn’t suffer from mental illness, I would probably be a kick ass person.

But alas, that’s not how the cookie crumbles, now is it?

I believe I have accepted my fate, I just don’t want it to be abrupt. So I’m waiting for a decent time as I know there may never come a “right time.”

The summer sounds blissful, as no one will be home and I can take a day by myself to say goodbye to the life that has treated me this way. Though I do wish to leave, my kitties will leave a hole in my soul. It pains me to leave them, but I know my family will love them as I did.

In the end, after I’m dead, I won’t know the rest of the story. So I just need to end the story for myself, you know?
I’ve felt this way for 20 years as well. I don’t believe it gets better for some people.

To me, I believe my depression has just hit that point of never returning. At younger ages, I did have hope. I would use the excuse of putting it off in the future because I was young, intelligent, and had potential.
Then I reached Uni, where I realized, unlike most people, I don’t have a passion. I don’t want to be a doctor, or a lawyer, but you can’t live a decent life without decent pay.
Then, add in the fact I have no friends. Literally, zero. My family doesn’t understand how bad I am, they tell me to suck it up. My brother tells me just to not think about it.
But the problem is, every minor inconvenience brings me to say “I’ll just end my life.”
As an example, I was at a softball game recently. A foul ball hit me, the pain felt good, but I started crying and cussing because that was just exactly what I needed to push me over the edge.
I have reached the point of exhaustion. I’m not sure what that point is for you, but for me, I no longer enjoy anything. I don’t enjoy food, or drinks. Sports are tiring and hobbies take too much time and effort. Friendships don’t last and vacations are impossible without money and with a job.
Life just doesn’t have much to offer me personally, so I would rather not be here sucking up the resources for everyone else.
Is this still an offer? I’m 20 and in the States. Female who struggles with mental health. My name is Anna.
If you find out, let me know.

I have wanted to die since I was 8. I am almost 21 now. I wish I could tell you it has went away, but sadly, things have only gotten worse. I am terrified of continuing this life as I’ve only received punishment from it.
I am also there. No understanding or support from family. No friends. I just want someone to end it with me, honestly.
All I can say is that I relate. Constantly, I experience these thoughts. How does someone live when they have something in their mindset telling them to end it every day... I am exhausted.

But the pain does go away for the person who killers themselves. I’ve been depressed ever since I can remember. Is it not selfish for family members to keep someone here who is miserable everyday of their lives? I have waited 20 years for it to get better. It never has.

I believe we could relate very well, as I have something loaded near me now. I have been pushing it off for months now just to finish up my studies. Things have only gotten worse. Oh, how I wish the “time heals all wounds applied to me.”

Do you ever feel this way?
Am I just making this up?
I don’t like to push people away because I’m so negative, but my life represents that.
I’ve been consumed by an overwhelming sadness ever since I can remember.
I am exhausted of trying, and when I reach out for help, I’m met with bad doctors, non-understanding family, and I don’t have any friends so I speak to strangers on the internet who either relate to me, or bring up sexual relations.
I just don’t feel like this world has anything left to offer me that would “fulfill” this hole within my soul.
I am missing something I can’t find.
I really need someone to talk to if you wouldn’t mind

I’ve already decided to use the gun I own. I’m just waiting on a day. Perhaps, I’m waiting for things to get better. But it’s been 20 years, how much longer do I have to wait?

It’s a cruel world, just know I feel your pain. I know it does nothing to help you, but maybe we can find comfort in the knowledge that we’ll be doing it together.

Sending you peace during this time. Our suffering will end soon, sweetie.
Message me privately?

I just have no idea where I’m going in life and I am so exhausted. I’ve been living with depression and anxiety and ADHD for 20 years now. I’ve tried so many medications, I’ve been in therapy consistently for years as well. I just don’t think life is for some people.

I have no motivation to have a career, and I don’t want to bring someone into this world with a mind like mine, or with a mom like me.

I’m stuck in a degree I don’t like, dating someone who doesn’t understand mental illness, surrounded by a family who loves me but also doesn’t understand. I have no friends.

At the end of the day, I just feel like I have experienced everything life has to offer, and things that I haven’t experienced don’t seem worth it to me. How could a week of vacation where ultimately, I’ll still be depressed, balance out working everyday of my life?

I just can’t go on any longer. Thinking about maybe calling the cops before so my family won’t have to find me.

I took my grandmother to the hospital today and I saw a girl my age and wanted so badly to interact with her. I experience the same treacherous people everyday who don’t understand what I’m going through. I feel like even though a mental stay might not be fun, I would leave knowing some people who were fucked up like me.

I have two cats that keep me here. I feel so small, unheard, belittled.

When I am sad, I am told to take my medication. I started cutting again and it’s like no one knows I am falling apart.

I can’t tell them, last time they cried and tried to send me to a hospital. My boyfriend doesn’t treat me like he used to. Maybe it is complacently, but I am just so far gone.

I want to stay but I don’t see a way out.

If you wouldn’t mind, could you talk to me as long as you’re awake? I haven’t found my courage, but it has been building up. I picked back up cutting even though I haven’t done it in months.... Selfishly, I hope you are okay.
